integrity: The exact finite counts are reproduced from the embedded checker by exhaustive enumeration. No independence or external validation is claimed.
limitations: The theorem concerns one explicit codimension-two subspace of the ternary field-spread MRD model. It neither constructs nor rules out a \(12\)-dimensional distance-\(3\) Ferrers-diagram code and does not classify other ternary MRD models.
title: A ternary kernel surviving the Ferrers rank-two obstruction
